about: Public defaults. They describe the fully synthetic demo house. data/private/config.local.json, when present, overrides any key (deep merge). Private names and identifiers belong only in that private file.
bandsAbout: The bands the page shows. A band needs an entry in pathLoss and a loss_db value per material in data/materials.json. Add a band there and list it here to use the same floor plan for another radio band.

home.label: Home router
home.role: Main router from the internet provider, dual band Wi-Fi 5

mesh.label: Mesh
mesh.role: Three-point Wi-Fi 5 mesh behind the home router

wave.about: Display settings for the wave animation. The real wavelength is 12.3 cm at 2.4 GHz and 5.7 cm at 5 GHz. The animation uses a longer wavelength so that single wavefronts are visible.
wave.modelAbout: beacon = one short pulse per beacon from each access point, brightness from the calibrated signal level. flow = the same with energy-flow arrows. tone = the earlier continuous tone with automatic brightness.
wave.beaconAbout: beaconPeriod_s is how long one real beacon interval (102.4 ms) takes on screen. pulseCycles is the length of one pulse in whole wave periods.
